examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}{入試|にゅうし}に{向|む}けて{勉強|べんきょう}している。
examples.english: I am studying for the university entrance exam.

examples.japanese: {入試|にゅうし}の{結果|けっか}が{発表|はっぴょう}された。
examples.english: The entrance exam results were announced.

examples.japanese: {入試|にゅうし}{問題|もんだい}は{思|おも}ったより{難|むずか}しかった。
examples.english: The entrance exam questions were harder than I expected.

notes:
{入試|にゅうし} is an abbreviation of {入学|にゅうがく}{試験|しけん} (entrance examination).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入試|にゅうし}を{受|う}ける (take an entrance exam)
- {入試|にゅうし}に{合格|ごうかく}する (pass an entrance exam)
- {入試|にゅうし}に{落|お}ちる (fail an entrance exam)
- {入試|にゅうし}{対策|たいさく} (entrance exam preparation)
- {入試|にゅうし}{問題|もんだい} (entrance exam questions)

TYPES:
- {高校|こうこう}{入試|にゅうし} (high school entrance exam)
- {大学|だいがく}{入試|にゅうし} (university entrance exam)
- {推薦|すいせん}{入試|にゅうし} (recommendation-based admission)
- AO{入試|にゅうし} (admissions office exam - holistic review)
- {一般|いっぱん}{入試|にゅうし} (general entrance exam)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{受験|じゅけん}{戦争|せんそう} (exam war) describes the intense pressure Japanese students face during entrance exam season.
